badge.restart_gap_tip_one: {n} HA restart gap: power trace has a hole

btn.auto_label_cycles_tip: Name unlabelled cycles whose match confidence clears the threshold.
btn.delete_group_tip: Delete this group only - the member profiles are kept
btn.discard_tip: Discard the recorded trace without saving
btn.force_stop_tip: Immediately end the current cycle and mark it as force-stopped
btn.label: Label
btn.new_group_tip: Group near-identical profiles (same shape, different temperature or spin) so matching can tell them apart.
btn.new_profile_tip: Create a new program profile from an existing labelled cycle or recording
btn.pause_cycle_tip: Pause the running cycle – the appliance will resume where it left off
btn.pg_apply_to_settings_tip: Copy the values you edited here into this device's live settings
btn.pg_load_live_tip: Re-read the integration's current settings and drop every Playground edit
btn.pg_load_suggested_tip: Stage the auto-tuner's current suggestions as Playground overrides
btn.pg_preset_load_tip: Replace the Playground values with this preset (live settings are untouched)
btn.pg_preset_save_tip: Save every value below as a named preset for this device
btn.process_tip: Save the recorded trace as a new or existing profile
btn.rebuild_tip: Rebuild every profile's expected power band from its labelled cycles. Run after labelling or correcting cycles.
btn.rec_start_tip: Begin recording the appliance's power trace – start just before running a cycle
btn.rec_stop_tip: Stop recording and hold the captured trace for review
btn.reset_ml_models_tip: Discard the fine-tuned models and go back to the built-in ones. WashData can re-learn them later.
btn.reset_phase_tip: Undo your edit and restore the built-in phase
btn.revert_settings_tip: Restore settings from before your last save
btn.revert_to_previous: Restore this setting to its previous value
btn.run_analysis_tip: Analyze your recorded cycles now and refresh tuning suggestions
btn.share_device_tip: Share this appliance and its reference cycles to the community store so owners of the same machine can adopt them.
btn.unlabel_selected_tip: Remove the label from the selected cycles. They stay in your history but stop shaping this profile.

off_delay.effective: A finished cycle actually waits {eff} s, not {delay} s: Min Off Gap ({gap} s) is longer and takes precedence.

anti_wrinkle_max.max: Must be above Start Threshold ({start} W); otherwise anti-wrinkle duration limit is bypassed
anti_wrinkle_max.start: Must be below Anti-Wrinkle Max Power ({max} W)

price_entity.power_sensor: This is the device's Power Sensor, not a price. Cycles would be costed in watts per kWh; clear this field.
price_entity.energy_sensor: This is the device's Energy Meter, not a price. Cycles would be costed at the meter reading per kWh; clear this field.
price_entity.device_class: This sensor measures {dc}, not a price per kWh. Clear this field or pick a tariff sensor.
price_entity.unit: This sensor reads in {unit}, not a price per kWh. Clear this field or pick a tariff sensor.

conflict.settings_banner: Setting conflicts: {n}. Check the highlighted sections and fix them before saving.

confidence.auto: Must be at or above Match Threshold ({match})
confidence.learning: Must be at or above Match Threshold ({match})
confidence.match_for_auto: Must be at or below Auto-Label Confidence ({alc})
confidence.match_for_learning: Must be at or below Learning Confidence ({lc})

duration_ratio.max: Must be greater than Min Duration Ratio ({min})
duration_ratio.min: Must be less than Max Duration Ratio ({max})

hysteresis.start: Must be above Stop Threshold ({stop} W)
hysteresis.stop: Must be below Start Threshold ({start} W)

min_power.min_power: Must be at or below Stop Threshold ({stop} W)
min_power.stop: Must be at or above Min Power ({min} W)

no_update_timeout.timeout: Must be greater than Watchdog Interval ({wi} s)
no_update_timeout.watchdog: Must be less than No-Update Timeout ({to} s)

off_delay.gap: Min Off Gap should be at least Off Delay ({delay} s)
off_delay.off_delay: Off Delay ({off_delay} s) exceeds Min Off Gap ({gap} s); consecutive cycles may merge

power_off.stop: Must be above Power Off Threshold ({pot} W)
power_off.threshold: Must be below Stop Threshold ({stop} W) to take effect

pump_stuck.duration: Must be below No-Update Timeout ({to} s) so the stuck alarm can fire first
pump_stuck.timeout: Must exceed Pump Stuck Duration ({ps} s) so the stuck alarm can fire first

start_dur.sampling: Sampling Interval exceeds Start Duration ({sdt} s); single-sample spikes can open a cycle
start_dur.threshold: Should be at least one Sampling Interval ({si} s) to prevent single-sample false starts

unmatch.unmatch: Must be below Match Threshold ({match}); otherwise a committed match un-matches instantly

conflict.suggestion_resolves: Stage the pending suggestion ({val}) below to fix this

watchdog.interval: Should be at least 2x Sampling Interval ({si} s)
watchdog.sampling: Sampling Interval should be at most half of Watchdog Interval ({wi} s)

end_energy.energy: Too strict for Stop Threshold ({w} W) over Off Delay ({d} s); the cycle can only end through a fallback path
end_energy.stop: End Energy Threshold ({e} Wh over {d} s) only permits {p} W

hdr.no_automations: No automations reference this device yet.

ml.trend_improving_tip: This model's fit has improved across recent re-checks.
ml.trend_declining_tip: This model's fit has slipped across recent re-checks – reviewing more cycles may help it re-learn.
ml.trend_steady_tip: This model's fit has held roughly steady across recent re-checks.

skip_reason.insufficient_rows_one: Not enough usable cycles yet: {count} labelled, clean cycle so far.
skip_reason.insufficient_rows_other: Not enough usable cycles yet: {count} labelled, clean cycles so far.

modal.remove_task_msg: Remove the reminder "{task}"? Its entries in the maintenance log are kept.
modal.apply_suggestions_msg: Change these {n} settings? The integration reloads after saving.
modal.delete_automation_msg: Delete the automation "{name}" from Home Assistant? This cannot be undone.
modal.delete_maintenance_msg: Delete this maintenance record? This cannot be undone.
modal.discard_recording_msg: Discard the saved recording? This cannot be undone.
modal.discard_settings_msg: {n} setting change(s) are not saved yet. Leave Settings and discard them?
modal.force_stop_msg: Force-stop the active cycle now? The cycle will be saved as interrupted.
modal.process_history_msg: Re-run matching, refresh suggestions, retrain ML (if enabled), recost cycles against recorded energy prices and recompute cycle health across all stored cycles. This may take a while.
modal.remove_legacy_msg: Remove the legacy custom actions? They will stop firing on cycle events. This cannot be undone from the panel.
modal.reset_phase_msg: Undo your edit of "{name}" and restore the built-in phase? Programs keep their ranges.
modal.undo_import_msg: This device's data and settings go back to how they were before the last import ({when}). Cycles recorded and changes made since then are lost.

msg.custom_task_limit: You have reached the limit of {max} tasks.
msg.custom_tasks_intro: Add anything else you want to be reminded of. A task is due when either interval is reached; leave one blank or 0 to use only the other.
msg.maintenance_due_sensor_hint: The Maintenance due binary sensor is on while any task is due, for your own notification automations.
msg.maintenance_supporter_intro: Maintenance Supporter is a separate integration that does much more: any appliance or task, schedules by time, usage or a sensor, notifications and a history. It can use the WashData cycle counter.
msg.adopt_settings_hint: Overwrite this device's detection & matching thresholds with the shared ones. Your notifications, entities and energy price are never changed.
msg.advisory_duration_trend_up: '{name}' cycles keep getting longer (about +{pct}% per cycle). If the appliance changed, re-record or rebuild this profile.
msg.advisory_energy_trend_up: '{name}' uses more energy each cycle (about +{pct}% per cycle). Check the appliance if that is unexpected.
msg.advisory_poor_health: '{name}' fits poorly: its recent cycles vary a lot or match weakly. Review its cycles or re-record it to keep matching and estimates accurate.
msg.advisory_shape_drift: '{name}' has drifted from its original power shape, perhaps from limescale or wear. Consider re-recording it with recent cycles.
msg.advisory_shape_drift_corr: '{name}' has drifted from its original power shape (correlation {corr}), perhaps from limescale or wear. Consider re-recording it with recent cycles.
msg.advisory_unmatchable: '{name}' can never match: no cycle with power data is behind it. Label or record a cycle of this program to fix it.
msg.advisory_unmatchable_no_duration: '{name}' can never match: its cycle has no usable duration. Re-record this program or set its expected duration.
msg.artifact_dip_detail: Dropped below the usual power band for ~{n}s.
msg.artifact_footer: Highlighted on the graph above. These are transient artifacts (e.g. the door opened mid-cycle), not necessarily problems.
msg.artifact_pause_detail: Power dropped to near zero for ~{n}s, then resumed. The door was probably opened or the cycle paused.
msg.artifact_spike_detail: Drew above the usual power band for ~{n}s.
msg.auto_label_intro: Assign profiles to unlabelled cycles whose match confidence clears the threshold.
msg.automations_intro: WashData fires {start} / {end} events and exposes entities, so notifications and actions are best built as normal Home Assistant automations. Automations that use this device appear below.
msg.cleanup_intro: All labelled cycles overlaid. Tick outliers, then unlabel them (kept in history, no longer shaping this profile) or delete them.
msg.clear_debug_hint: Remove stored debug data to free space.
msg.collecting_data: Collecting data. Cycles still needed before fine-tuning can start: {need} ({current}/{min}).
msg.compare_overlay_tip: Overlay learned profile envelopes to see which program each cycle resembles.
msg.compare_profiles_tip: Overlay other profiles on the chart to see which fits this cycle best.
msg.cycle_context_note: Grey: the power sensor's recorder history around this cycle. It is not part of the cycle and does not affect duration, energy or matching.
msg.cycle_context_none: The recorder holds no readings around this cycle (Home Assistant keeps 10 days of history by default).
msg.cycle_context_tip: Display only: shows the power sensor's recorder history around this cycle, if still kept. To add failed start attempts to future cycles, use Curve Pre-roll (Settings > Detection > Cycle Start), which changes stored durations.
msg.dest_real_history_hint: Imported cycles count as this device's own history and statistics. Use this to move an appliance to a new install.
msg.dest_reference_hint: Imported cycles only improve program matching and never affect usage/energy statistics.
msg.device_type_mismatch_warn: This export is from a different appliance type ({src} vs {local}). Programs and cycles can still be imported as reference data, but not device settings or real history.
msg.enough_data: Enough data to learn from ({current}/{min} cycles).
msg.export_description: Choose exactly which profiles, cycles, settings and more to export to JSON, or analyze a file and import only the parts you want.
msg.export_select_intro: Tick what to include. Profiles without their cycles still export a matchable program.
msg.feedback_prompt: Confirm it was right, correct the program, or ignore.
msg.feedback_relabel_hint: Re-labelling this cycle resolves it too.
msg.font_size_hint: Make everything in this panel larger or smaller. Applies to your account on this device.
msg.group_modal_help: Group programs with the same shape that differ in temperature or spin. Matching scores the group as one, then picks the best-fitting member. Pick at least 2; the overlay shows how alike they are.
msg.group_not_cohesive: These profiles aren't similar enough to group reliably, so matching treats them individually until you remove the outlier or split the group.
msg.group_preview_hint: Tick 2+ members to preview and compare their power curves.
msg.head_trim_hint: Remove this many seconds from the start
msg.hist_breaks: {n} gaps where the sensor was unavailable
msg.hist_capped: The per-device limit for imported cycles was reached; the rest were not stored.
msg.hist_duplicates: {n} were already imported and were skipped.
msg.hist_found: Found {n} cycles. Untick anything that does not look like a real run - nothing is stored until you import.
msg.hist_input_hint: Upload a CSV from the History panel (entity, state, last changed), or let WashData read the sensor's history directly. Live detection runs over it and you choose which cycles to keep.
msg.hist_next_step: They are in your Cycles list, tagged as imported history. Open one and use Label to name its program.
msg.hist_none_found: No cycles could be detected in that history.
msg.hist_recorder_empty: Home Assistant has no detailed history for this sensor in that window.
msg.hist_recorder_hint: Reads from the date you pick until now. Home Assistant keeps detailed history for 10 days by default; older hourly averages are too coarse for cycle detection.
msg.hist_scan_capped: Only the first candidates are shown ({n} were found).
msg.hist_scan_expired: That scan is no longer available. Scan again.
msg.hist_scanning: Running your history through the detector in the background. You can close this dialog and come back.
msg.hist_settings_used: Detected using this device's current settings (minimum power {w} W, off delay {s} s).
msg.import_analyze_hint: Load an exported file (or paste its JSON). WashData shows what can be imported before anything changes.
msg.import_history_description: Had a smart plug before WashData? Upload its power history or read it from Home Assistant. Detection runs over it, and past cycles appear in your Cycles list ready to name.
msg.import_undo_hint: A restore point from before the last import ({when}) is kept: {profiles} profile(s) and {cycles} cycle(s).
msg.imported_history_readonly: Found in imported power history. It helps matching but is not counted in your statistics and cannot be trimmed or split. Label it to name the program.
msg.imported_readonly: Imported from the community store. Used for reference and matching, not counted in your stats, and cannot be edited.
msg.include_settings_hint: Share this device's detection and matching thresholds (not notifications, entities or energy price). Others choose whether to apply them.
msg.live_chart_loading: Live power chart appears as readings arrive.
msg.log_buffer_hint: Newest first · buffers the last 500 ha_washdata records since restart · drag the bottom edge to resize.
msg.maintenance_intro: Log servicing on this appliance and get reminded when each task is due again.
msg.maintenance_requires_access: Maintenance and export/import require full access.
msg.manual_duration_hint: The profile's expected cycle length, used for time-remaining estimates. Leave it unchanged to keep the current value.
msg.manual_duration_ref_hint: Only used without a reference cycle; a reference cycle sets the duration from its own length.
msg.duration_learned_hint: Worked out from this program's cycles (outliers left out) and updated after each new one. To change it, trim or remove the cycles that are off.
msg.merge_hint: Imported items are added; nothing local is lost. Name clashes are resolved below.
msg.merge_intro: The selected cycles are combined into one (chronological order; gaps filled with 0 W). Pick the resulting profile.
msg.merge_no_imports: Imported recordings cannot be merged into a real cycle. Deselect them to merge.
msg.ml_intro: WashData ships with smart models that work out of the box.
msg.ml_settings_intro: Two independent switches: one applies the models while a cycle runs, the other lets WashData fine-tune them to your machine over time.
msg.n_suggestions_muted: {count} muted; the auto-tuner will not propose these.
msg.n_suggestions_muted_one: {count} suggestion muted; the auto-tuner will not propose it.
msg.n_suggestions_muted_other: {count} suggestions muted; the auto-tuner will not propose these.
msg.no_cycles_match: No cycles match the current filter.
msg.no_cycles_selected: Select at least one cycle first.
msg.no_envelope: No envelope yet - rebuild after labelling cycles.
msg.no_fine_tuned: Nothing fine-tuned yet – WashData is using its built-in models.
msg.no_logs_match: No log records match these filters.
msg.no_match_yet: No match attempt yet - this populates during a running cycle.
msg.no_other_users: No other Home Assistant users found.
msg.no_profiles_yet: No profiles yet. Create one from a labelled cycle.
msg.no_reminders_set: No service reminders are set yet.
msg.notify_services_hint: Use {entity} service IDs (comma-separated for multiple). Template variables: {vars}.
msg.odometer_correct_hint: Set this if WashData counted a run that never happened, or the appliance ran cycles before WashData was installed.
msg.odometer_intro: This total only goes up. Deleting a cycle does not lower it, so service reminders stay correct.
msg.old_actions_warning: Configured with the old actions editor (now removed). They still fire on cycle events but can no longer be edited here. Convert them into a normal automation, or remove them.
msg.onboard_download: New device? Adopt a ready-made setup (programs, reference cycles and phases) from another WashData user with the same appliance.
msg.online_intro_global: Browse and share reference recordings with other WashData users. One connection covers all your WashData devices; brand and model are set per device under Basic. Online features are off until you turn them on.
msg.online_unavailable: Online features are not available on this server.
msg.pg_analysis_hint2: Pick a cycle and press Run to load match analysis.
msg.pg_apply_settings_confirm: Save these {n} setting(s) to this device? {list}
msg.pg_canvas_empty3: Pick a cycle above and press Run to simulate it. Then hover to read values, scroll or pinch to zoom, and drag to pan.
msg.pg_ctrl_intro: Values start from this device's live integration settings. Edits stay in the Playground until you publish them.
msg.pg_history_empty: Press Run to replay your cycles.
msg.pg_history_intro2: Replay recent cycles through the real detector and matcher with the settings above. Click a row to load it in the graph; change a setting to compare before and after.
msg.pg_in_sample_note: These cycles helped build the profiles they are matched against, so results are optimistic: expect slightly fewer correct matches on new cycles.
msg.pg_load_live_confirm: Discard {n} Playground edit(s) and reload the integration's current settings?
msg.pg_no_alerts: No issues detected in this run.
msg.pg_override_active: Using your edited settings vs. current
msg.pg_restart_note: Restart Home Assistant to enable simulation tools.
msg.pg_row_load_hint: Load this cycle in the graph above
msg.pg_sugg_none: All suggestions already match the current settings
msg.pg_sweep_intro2: Find the setting that best meets an objective across your recent cycles. Nothing changes until you apply it.
msg.pg_sweep_no_metric: Not enough data to score this objective.
msg.phase_catalog_intro: Named segments of a cycle (Pre-wash, Heating, Spin…). Assign them to a profile from its control panel.
msg.phase_ranges_intro: Phase ranges (minutes from cycle start) overlaid on the average curve. Edit values to preview live.
msg.playground_intro: Try settings on your real cycle data. Nothing here changes your live settings until you apply it.
msg.prefs_personal: These apply to your Home Assistant account only.
msg.process_history_hint: Re-run matching on all stored cycles, refresh suggestions, retrain ML models (if enabled), recost cycles from recorded prices and recompute cycle health. Run it after a batch of reviews.
msg.profiles_intro: Click a profile for stats, phases and cleanup. Group near-identical programs (same shape/duration, different temperature or spin) so matching reliably picks between them.
msg.rbac_hint: Off: every Home Assistant user has full access (default). Administrators always have full access and can manage everyone.
msg.refresh_catalog_hint: Community brand and appliance lists are cached to save the store's daily budget. Refresh to see entries others added or approved.
msg.reminders_intro: Show a reminder in the panel this many cycles after the last service. Leave blank or 0 to turn a reminder off.
msg.replace_undo_hint: A restore point is saved first, so you can undo this import from Export / Import.
msg.replace_warn: Each ticked category is wiped and replaced from the file. Unticked categories are left untouched.
msg.restart_gap_footer: Highlighted on the graph. Power data is missing for these intervals; matching used only real readings.
msg.restart_gap_header: {n} HA restart gap during this cycle
msg.restart_gap_header_one: {n} HA restart gap during this cycle
msg.restart_gap_header_other: {n} HA restart gaps during this cycle
msg.review_confirm_help: Was this cycle detected correctly? Confirming cycles improves matching for your machine. A quick Good/Bad is enough.
msg.review_notes_tip: Free-text notes for your own reference. Not used by matching or training.
msg.review_profile_tip: The program this cycle is labelled as. If it is wrong, correct it here; labels teach matching.
msg.review_quality_tip: How clean this cycle is. Good: a textbook run of this program. Bad: detected, but noisy or unusual. Unusable: mis-detected (merged, cut short or spurious). Affects the health score and which cycles train the model.
msg.review_recorded_tip: Mark this as a hand-picked reference cycle for its program, like a manually recorded cycle. Reference cycles are always kept, seed the matching template, and are never removed by cleanup.
msg.review_tags_tip: Optional flags for what went wrong, so training and cleanup can allow for it.
msg.samples_decimated: Showing {shown} of {total} samples (thinned for display; peaks kept). A wide gap here is thinning, not missing data.
msg.saving_triggers_reload: Saving reloads the integration. Entities may briefly show as unavailable.
msg.settings_basic_note: Showing essential settings. Switch to Advanced for the full list.
msg.share_device_none: No shareable cycles yet. Mark a recorded or hand-picked cycle as a reference cycle (⭐) in the Cycles tab first.
msg.share_guideline_naming: Name each profile exactly as shown on the appliance dial or display (e.g. 'Cotton 40', 'Eco 60').
msg.share_guideline_quality: Only share cycles that finished normally: no interruptions, door openings or power blips.
msg.share_guideline_review: Your upload starts as pending and appears publicly once enough community members confirm it.
msg.share_profile_no_cycles: No reference cycles – mark a cycle as ⭐ in the Cycles tab to include this profile
msg.split_intro: Click the graph to add or remove a split point, or auto-detect by idle gaps. Each part can get its own profile.
msg.store_declare_appliance: Tell WashData which appliance you own to see setups others shared for it. Or type a brand above to look around.
msg.store_download_device_intro: Add every shared program and its reference cycles to your device. Your own cycles and stats are not affected.
msg.store_enable_hint: Turn on online features in Preferences > Online & Community to browse and import community reference cycles.
msg.advisory_duration_outlier: {n} cycle(s) labelled ‘{name}’ are too far from its usual length to ever match (worst: {ratio}x). They are probably mislabelled or hold two runs. Relabel or split them so they stop skewing its time estimate.
msg.standby_above_stop_title: Still drawing {idle} W when the cycle ended
msg.standby_above_stop_sub: {n} of the last {total} cycles. The off delay only starts once power is below the Stop Threshold ({stop} W), so cycles finish late or need stopping by hand.
msg.store_picker_offline: Enable online features in the settings gear to pick from the community catalog.
msg.store_share_device_intro: Upload {brand} {model} with the reference cycles you select. Others with the same appliance can adopt your programs. Entries are reviewed before appearing publicly.
msg.store_share_intro: Upload this reference cycle so others with the same appliance can use it. It is reviewed before appearing publicly.
msg.store_sibling_hint: Nothing shared for your model? A related model from the same brand is usually a good start.
msg.tail_trim_hint: Remove this many seconds from the end
msg.toast_automation_migrated: Actions migrated to an automation; opening editor
msg.toast_convert_orphan: The automation was created, but clearing the old actions failed. Do not retry: remove the legacy actions manually to avoid a duplicate automation.
msg.toast_convert_rolled_back: Migration failed and was rolled back (no automation left behind): {error}
msg.toast_program_armed: Program armed for the next cycle: {program}
msg.trim_destructive_confirm: This keeps only {pct}% of the cycle and cannot be undone. Continue?
msg.trim_intro: Drag the red handles, or enter values. Everything outside the window is removed.
msg.tuning_suggestions_available: {count} tuning suggestion available from observed cycles. They appear beside the relevant fields.
msg.tuning_suggestions_available_one: {count} tuning suggestion available from observed cycles. It appears beside the relevant field.
msg.tuning_suggestions_available_other: {count} tuning suggestions available from observed cycles. They appear beside the relevant fields.
msg.warmup_detail: Matching already works. WashData asks you to confirm the first {needed} cycles of this profile before labelling on its own.
msg.wipe_history_warning: Permanently delete all cycles and profiles. Cannot be undone.
msg.edit_builtin_phase: This is a built-in phase. Saving creates a custom copy; delete the copy to restore the original.
msg.pg_notify_partial: Markers show start, almost-done, finish, milestone and quiet-hours notifications only. Live updates, unload reminders and overrun alerts are not simulated.
msg.connect_to_confirm: Connect in the settings gear to confirm or rate.
msg.coverage_gap_cluster: {count} recent unlabelled cycles of about {min} min look like one program you have not created yet.
msg.pg_label_yes: Would be labelled "{name}" at cycle end
msg.live_match_debug_tip: Confidence: how closely the current power curve matches the top candidate profile (0-100%). Ambiguous: the two best candidates score within 5% of each other - the label is uncertain until the cycle finishes.
msg.automation_desc_started: Runs when a {device} cycle starts. Add your actions (notify, lights, ...).
msg.automation_desc_finished: Runs when a {device} cycle finishes. Add your actions (notify, lights, ...).
msg.pg_outcome_stale: Settings changed since this simulation ran. It still shows the old result.
msg.pg_compare_profile_tip: Only picks the profile drawn over the graph. The simulation always matches the cycle on its own, as the live integration does.
msg.pg_task_busy: A Test-on-history or Optimize run is already in progress for this device. Wait for it or cancel it.
msg.pg_sweep_guarded: Ends more cycles early, splits more of them, or misses cycles the current setting catches, so it is never recommended.
msg.pg_sweep_keep_current: Keep the current value ({value}, {metric}): no value did better by at least one cycle.
msg.hist_truncated: stopped at the {n}-reading limit, so the rest of the history was not scanned
msg.hist_warn_kw: The highest reading is only {w}. This sensor seems to report kilowatts; WashData needs watts, so no cycles can be detected.
msg.hist_warn_naive_time: {n} timestamps have no time zone and were read as UTC. If the file uses local time, cycles are shifted by your UTC offset and readings near a DST change may be dropped.
msg.hist_warn_naive_time_one: {n} timestamp has no time zone and was read as UTC. If the file uses local time, cycles are shifted by your UTC offset and readings near a DST change may be dropped.
msg.hist_warn_naive_time_other: {n} timestamps have no time zone and were read as UTC. If the file uses local time, cycles are shifted by your UTC offset and readings near a DST change may be dropped.
msg.hist_tail_trimmed: {min} min of waiting after the cycle ended were trimmed, as the live integration trims them
msg.invalid_threshold_pair: Stop Threshold ({stop} W) must be below Start Threshold ({start} W). Nothing was saved; change both together.

pg_desc.completion_min_seconds: Shortest run that counts as a real cycle
pg_desc.min_off_gap: Gap required to separate two cycles
pg_desc.off_delay: Seconds of low power before cycle ends
pg_desc.start_duration_threshold: Seconds above threshold to confirm start
pg_desc.start_threshold_w: Minimum watts to count as started
pg_desc.stop_threshold_w: Below this, machine counts as off
pg_desc.profile_match_min_duration_ratio: Minimum cycle length as a fraction of the profile's duration; default 0.1 (10%)
pg_desc.profile_match_max_duration_ratio: Maximum cycle length as a fraction of the profile's duration; default 1.8 (180%)
pg_desc.anti_wrinkle_idle_timeout: Quiet time allowed between two tumble pulses before anti-wrinkle ends
pg_desc.dishwasher_end_spike_quiet_release: Dishwasher: quiet seconds after expected duration before the end-of-cycle drain wait is released
pg_desc.smart_termination_duration_ratio: Fraction of the program's average duration a cycle must reach before Smart Termination may end it early; lower it if run times vary
pg_desc.anti_crease_finalize_ratio: Fraction of the program's average duration a cycle must reach before the anti-crease tail may finish it; lower it on dryers, keep washers at the default
pg_desc.anti_wrinkle_max_power: A pulse above this ends anti-wrinkle and opens a new cycle
pg_desc.anti_wrinkle_enabled: Absorb the tumble pulses after the main phase instead of reading them as new cycles
pg_desc.anti_wrinkle_max_duration: A pulse longer than this ends anti-wrinkle and opens a new cycle
pg_desc.anti_wrinkle_exit_power: Quiet level between tumble pulses; only takes effect above the Stop Threshold
pg_desc.curve_preroll_seconds: Seconds of readings from aborted start attempts carried into the front of a cycle's curve; 0 = off

phase_desc.anti_crease: Occasional short tumbles after completion to reduce wrinkles.
phase_desc.anti_wrinkle: Periodic post-cycle tumbling to reduce wrinkles.
phase_desc.baking: High-temperature heating element active for crust and crumb formation.
phase_desc.cooking: Main cooking phase with active heater and fan.
phase_desc.cool_down: Tumbling without heat near cycle end.
phase_desc.drain_and_switch: Transition period from washing to drying mode.
phase_desc.dry: Drying stage using heater and/or residual heat.
phase_desc.heat_up: Initial heater warm-up before full drying begins.
phase_desc.keep_warm: Low-heat holding stage to keep food warm.
phase_desc.keep_warm_bm: Low-heat holding stage to keep the loaf warm after baking.
phase_desc.kneading: Motor-driven dough mixing and development. High power draw.
phase_desc.pause_af: Short pause for shaking or inspection.
phase_desc.pre_heat: Initial chamber heating before full cooking.
phase_desc.proving: Low-heat rising period to allow yeast fermentation and dough expansion.
phase_desc.resting: Short low-power pause between kneading stages for gluten relaxation.
phase_desc.pre_wash: Initial soak or pre-treatment before the main wash.
phase_desc.rinse: Clean-water rinse stage. This phase may repeat multiple times.
phase_desc.sanitize: High-temperature cleaning stage for sanitization programs.
phase_desc.sensor_check: Short low-power pause while dryness is measured.
phase_desc.soak: Low-activity soaking period between active wash stages.
phase_desc.soak_dw: Extended soak period for heavy soil.
phase_desc.spin: High-speed extraction to remove water from the load.
phase_desc.wash: Main washing cycle with drum movement and optional heating.

placeholder.maintenance_notes: e.g. replaced filter, cleaned door seal

anti_wrinkle.intro: Keeps a dryer's low-power tumble pulses after the main phase attached to the finished cycle.
anti_wrinkle.label: Anti-Wrinkle

basic.intro: Core identity and the essentials most setups need.
basic.label: Basic

delay.intro: Detects an appliance that is on and waiting for a delayed start.
delay.label: Delayed Start

detection.intro: How a cycle is detected as starting, running and finishing.
detection.label: Detection

dishwasher.intro: End handling for dishwashers, which often dry quietly for a long time before a short final drain.
dishwasher.label: Dishwasher

matching.intro: How finished cycles are matched to learned profiles and labelled.
matching.label: Matching

ml_training.intro: On-device machine learning retraining schedule and data settings.
ml_training.label: ML Training

notifications.intro: When and how you are notified about cycle events.
notifications.label: Notifications

timing.intro: Background cadence, the offline watchdog and housekeeping.
timing.label: Timing & Watchdog

triggers.intro: Optional extras: end trigger, door sensor, pause switch and unload reminder.
triggers.label: Triggers & Doors

anti_crease_finalize_ratio.doc: Fraction of the program's average duration a cycle must reach before its low-power tumbling counts as the anti-crease tail. Lower it (e.g. 0.75) on load-sensing dryers. Keep washers at the default (0.98), or a wash can end halfway.
anti_crease_finalize_ratio.label: Anti-Crease Finalize Ratio

anti_wrinkle_enabled.doc: Keep a dryer's short low-power tumble pulses after the main heat phase with the finished cycle, instead of reading them as new cycles.
anti_wrinkle_enabled.label: Enable Anti-Wrinkle Detection

anti_wrinkle_exit_power.doc: In anti-wrinkle mode, power below this counts as quiet between tumble pulses, and quiet for longer than the Max Pulse Gap ends the mode. The Stop Threshold is used when it is higher, so this only changes anything when set above the Stop Threshold.
anti_wrinkle_exit_power.label: Exit Power Threshold

anti_wrinkle_idle_timeout.label: Max Pulse Gap
anti_wrinkle_idle_timeout.doc: How long the dryer may stay quiet between tumble pulses before anti-wrinkle mode ends. Set it above your dryer's longest gap, or later pulses are read as false starts.

anti_wrinkle_max_duration.doc: A pulse longer than this counts as a real cycle, not an anti-wrinkle tumble.
anti_wrinkle_max_duration.label: Max Duration

anti_wrinkle_max_power.doc: A pulse above this power counts as a real new cycle, not a tumble. Set it just above your tumble-pulse power.
anti_wrinkle_max_power.label: Max Anti-Wrinkle Power

auto_label_confidence.doc: Match score at cycle end at or above which the program is labelled without asking. Raise it for more certainty; lower it to label more cycles automatically. Keep it above Learning Confidence.
auto_label_confidence.label: Auto-Label Confidence

auto_maintenance.doc: Nightly cleanup: label old cycles that now clearly match a program, rebuild program curves, refresh anomaly marks and cycle health, and remove debug traces if Save Debug Traces is off. Cycles and their power traces are always kept.
auto_maintenance.label: Auto Maintenance (nightly cleanup)

completion_min_seconds.doc: Cycles shorter than this (test runs, opening the door to add a sock) are saved as Interrupted and get no finish notification.
completion_min_seconds.label: Min Cycle Duration

curve_preroll_seconds.doc: Adds readings from failed start attempts to the front of a cycle, for machines that probe before starting (door lock, first fill). 300 s covers most; 0 = off. Recorded starts move earlier, so learned durations drift for a while.
curve_preroll_seconds.label: Curve Pre-roll

delay_confirm_seconds.doc: Power must stay in the standby band this long before the appliance counts as waiting to start.
delay_confirm_seconds.label: Confirm Seconds

delay_start_detect_enabled.doc: Detect an appliance that is on and waiting for a delayed start, so its standby draw is not taken for a running cycle.
delay_start_detect_enabled.label: Enable Delay-Start Detection

delay_timeout_hours.doc: Give up waiting for a delayed start after this many hours and return to idle.
delay_timeout_hours.label: Timeout Hours

device_type.doc: Sets detection defaults (thresholds, off delay, end handling) for this kind of appliance. Change it only if the device was set up as the wrong type.
device_type.label: Device Type

dishwasher_end_spike_quiet_release.doc: After the expected duration, how long the dishwasher must stay below the Stop Threshold before WashData stops waiting for the final drain. Raise it if a late drain after a long dry is missed. The wait never exceeds 30 minutes.
dishwasher_end_spike_quiet_release.label: Passive-Dry Quiet Release

door_end_dwell_seconds.label: Door-Open End Dwell
door_end_dwell_seconds.doc: With "Door Opens Automatically At End" on: how long the door must stay open before the cycle ends. Long enough to ignore adding a dish (default 60 s).

door_opens_at_end.label: Door Opens Automatically At End
door_opens_at_end.doc: For dishwashers that open the door at the end to dry (e.g. AirDry). A door left open for the dwell time below ends the cycle instead of pausing it; a brief open is ignored. Needs a Door Sensor Entity.

door_sensor_entity.doc: Optional door sensor. Shows when the appliance was opened to unload after a cycle.
door_sensor_entity.label: Door Sensor Entity

duration_tolerance.doc: Learning feedback only: a cycle within +/-X% of its estimated duration counts as a good estimate. Does not affect matching.
duration_tolerance.label: Estimate Tolerance

enable_ml_models.doc: Use a model trained on this machine to predict a running cycle's energy and cost, and let a well-known program that stops unusually early finish without the full off delay. Off: power-based logic only.
enable_ml_models.label: Apply smart models during a cycle

end_energy_threshold.doc: Energy allowed during the off delay. More than this and the cycle keeps going, so tumbles and drying tails stay attached. Lower it if cycles end during a tail; raise it if finished cycles keep waiting.
end_energy_threshold.label: End Energy

energy_price_dynamic.doc: Charge each cycle at the price at each moment it ran, instead of the price when it finished. Needs a price entity. Process History (Diagnostics) recosts older cycles.
energy_price_dynamic.label: Time-Weighted Cost

energy_price_entity.doc: Sensor with the current price per kWh (e.g. a dynamic tariff). It overrides the static price below, so it must be a price, not the plug's power or energy sensor.
energy_price_entity.label: Energy Price Entity

energy_price_static.doc: Fixed price per kWh, used when no price entity is set.
energy_price_static.label: Static Energy Price (per kWh)

energy_sensor.doc: Optional kWh or Wh counter (total_increasing, e.g. the plug's own meter). Cycle energy is then read from it, which is more accurate than computing it from a slow power sensor. If its reading is unusable, the computed value is used.
energy_sensor.label: Energy Meter Entity

expose_debug_entities.doc: Add diagnostic entities (match confidence, ambiguity, internal state). Off keeps the entity list clean.
expose_debug_entities.label: Expose Debug Entities

external_end_trigger.doc: Binary sensor whose change marks the cycle end (e.g. a "finished" contact or another integration).
external_end_trigger.label: External Trigger Entity

external_end_trigger_enabled.doc: Let a binary sensor signal the end of a cycle, in addition to power-based detection.
external_end_trigger_enabled.label: Enable External End Trigger

external_end_trigger_inverted.doc: Treat the sensor turning OFF (not ON) as the end signal.
external_end_trigger_inverted.label: Invert External Trigger (trigger on OFF)

learning_confidence.doc: Lowest match score for labelling a finished cycle. A clear winner is labelled; a close call goes to the review queue in Cycles. Below this, nothing is labelled or asked. Keep it below Auto-Label Confidence.
learning_confidence.label: Learning Confidence

linked_device.doc: Optional. Show this WashData device under another device (e.g. the smart plug) in Home Assistant, as "Connected via ...".
linked_device.label: Group Under Device

min_off_gap.doc: An off period shorter than this does not split a cycle, so soak pauses stay in one wash. Keep it shorter than the gap between back-to-back loads, or those merge into one cycle.
min_off_gap.label: Min Off Gap

min_power.doc: Readings below this count as 0 W (standby). Filters out the idle draw of smart plugs and standby LEDs.
min_power.label: Minimum Power

ml_training_enabled.doc: Retrain the energy model on this machine's finished cycles from time to time. A new model is kept only if it beats the simple estimate on test cycles.
ml_training_enabled.label: Learn from this machine

ml_training_hour.doc: Hour of day (0-23) for overnight training. Pick a quiet hour, e.g. 2.
ml_training_hour.label: Learn at hour

ml_training_interval_days.doc: Retrain at most once every this many days.
ml_training_interval_days.label: Check at most every

ml_training_min_cycles.doc: Wait for at least this many recorded cycles before training.
ml_training_min_cycles.label: Cycles needed first

name.doc: Name shown in Home Assistant for this device.
name.label: Device Name

no_update_active_timeout.doc: If no power update arrives for this long during a cycle, assume the plug went offline and force-stop the cycle. The default 600 s allows for cloud or mesh delays.
no_update_active_timeout.label: No-Update Timeout

notify_before_end_minutes.doc: Send an Almost Done alert when estimated time remaining drops below this. 0 disables it.
notify_before_end_minutes.label: Pre-End Alert

notify_channel.doc: Android channel for start and live messages; the channel sets sound and priority. Blank: app default.
notify_channel.label: Android Channel (start/live)

notify_cycle_timers.doc: Notifications at set minutes into a cycle (e.g. to add softener). Message supports {device}, {program}, {minutes}. With Auto-pause, the cycle also pauses there and the notification gets a Resume button.
notify_cycle_timers.label: Cycle Timers

notify_finish_channel.doc: Android channel for the finish message. Blank reuses the start/live channel.
notify_finish_channel.label: Android Channel (finish)

notify_finish_message.doc: Body sent when a cycle finishes. Variables: {device}, {program}, {duration} (minutes), {duration_hm} (1 h 05 min), {energy_kwh}, {cost}, {time_finished}, {vs_typical}, {cycle_count}, {status} (completed or force_stopped; interrupted cycles send nothing). Any other variable falls back to the default text.
notify_finish_message.label: Finish Message

notify_finish_services.doc: notify.* services to call when a cycle finishes. Leave empty for none.
notify_finish_services.label: Finish Services

notify_fire_events.doc: Also fire ha_washdata_* events on cycle start and finish for your own automations.
notify_fire_events.label: Fire HA Events for Notifications

notify_icon.doc: Small icon on the notification (e.g. mdi:washing-machine). Sent only to mobile_app targets, not notify groups. On iOS it replaces the app icon and needs companion app 2026.8 or newer. Blank: platform default.
notify_icon.label: Notification Icon

notify_icon_color.doc: Accent colour for this appliance's notifications, so washer, dryer and dishwasher are easy to tell apart. On iOS it fills the circle behind the icon and colours the Live Activity bar. Many Android phones (Samsung especially) ignore it. Use hex, e.g. #03A9F4. Blank: platform default.
notify_icon_color.label: Notification Colour

notify_live_chronometer.doc: Show a live countdown timer in the notification (where supported) instead of a fixed estimate.
notify_live_chronometer.label: Use Live Chronometer

notify_live_click_action.label: Notification Tap Target
notify_live_click_action.doc: What a tap on this appliance's notification opens. Blank: the WashData panel on this appliance. Enter a dashboard path (e.g. /lovelace/laundry) or URL, or "none" for no tap action.

notify_live_interval_seconds.doc: How often live-progress notifications are refreshed while a cycle runs.
notify_live_interval_seconds.label: Live Update Interval

notify_live_overrun_percent.doc: Live updates stop once a cycle runs this percent past its expected duration (20 = up to 1.2x the expected time).
notify_live_overrun_percent.label: Live Overrun % Before Alert

notify_live_services.doc: notify.* services for live progress updates while a cycle runs. Leave empty to turn them off.
notify_live_services.label: Live Progress Services

notify_live_silent.label: Silent Live Updates
notify_live_silent.doc: iOS only. Update live progress silently, at a battery-saving priority that iOS may batch. The first update and the start/finish notifications still alert. Off: every update alerts.

notify_live_sticky.label: Keep Live Notification On Tap
notify_live_sticky.doc: Android only. Keep the live progress notification when tapped. Off: a tap dismisses it.

notify_milestone_message.doc: Message for the milestone notification. Template variables: {device}, {cycle_count}.
notify_milestone_message.label: Milestone Message

notify_milestones.doc: Cycle counts that trigger a one-off celebration notification, comma-separated (e.g. 50, 100, 500, 1000). Blank disables them.
notify_milestones.label: Cycle Milestones

notify_only_when_home.doc: Only notify when at least one of the people above is home.
notify_only_when_home.label: Notify Only When Home

notify_people.doc: person.* entities that "Notify Only When Home" checks.
notify_people.label: People (for Only When Home)

notify_pre_complete_message.doc: Text of each live progress update. Template variables: {device}, {program}, {minutes} (minutes left). Any other variable falls back to the default text.
notify_pre_complete_message.label: Pre-Complete Message

notify_quiet_end_hour.doc: End of the do-not-disturb window (0-23); held notifications are sent then. Blank disables it.
notify_quiet_end_hour.label: Quiet Hours End

notify_quiet_start_hour.doc: Start of a do-not-disturb window (0-23). Finish, reminder and clean-laundry notifications in this window are held until it ends. Can cross midnight (e.g. 22 to 7). Blank disables it.
notify_quiet_start_hour.label: Quiet Hours Start

notify_reminder_message.doc: Text of the one-time Pre-End Alert. Template variables: {device}, {program}, {minutes} (the Pre-End Alert setting). Any other variable falls back to the default text.
notify_reminder_message.label: Reminder Message

notify_start_message.doc: Body sent when a cycle starts. Template variables: {device}, {program}. Any other variable falls back to the default text.
notify_start_message.label: Start Message

notify_start_services.doc: notify.* services to call when a cycle starts (phone, dashboard, ...). Leave empty for none.
notify_start_services.label: Start Services

notify_timeout_seconds.doc: Dismiss the notification after this many seconds (where supported). 0 keeps it until you dismiss it.
notify_timeout_seconds.label: Auto-Dismiss After

notify_title.doc: Notification title. Only {device} is substituted; any other variable falls back to the default title.
notify_title.label: Notification Title

notify_unload_delay_minutes.doc: Minutes after a cycle ends before the "unload the machine" reminder. 0 disables it.
notify_unload_delay_minutes.label: Unload Nag Delay

notify_unload_repeat.doc: Resend the unload reminder every "Unload Nag Delay" minutes until the unload is confirmed or you tap "Stop reminding" (mobile app). Needs a Door Sensor Entity, an Unload Confirmation Entity, or "Confirm Unload Manually".
notify_unload_repeat.label: Repeat Until Unloaded

off_delay.doc: How long power must stay low before the cycle is finished. Power coming back within this time continues the cycle. Dishwashers can be idle 20-60 min while drying, so set it longer than that.
off_delay.label: Off Delay

pause_cuts_power.doc: When a cycle is paused, also switch off the Switch Entity below. Only for appliances that can safely lose power mid-cycle.
pause_cuts_power.label: Pause Also Cuts Power (via switch)

peak_rate_message.doc: Custom text for the peak-rate tip. Template variables: {device}, {price}. Blank uses the default.
peak_rate_message.label: Peak-Rate Message

peak_rate_threshold.doc: If the price per kWh is at or above this when a cycle starts, add a peak-rate tip to the start notification. 0 or blank disables it.
peak_rate_threshold.label: Peak-Rate Threshold (per kWh)

power_off_delay.doc: How long power must stay below the Power Off Threshold after a cycle before the state returns to Off. Only used when that threshold is above 0. Checked periodically, so the real wait can be slightly longer.
power_off_delay.label: Power Off Delay

power_off_threshold_w.doc: After a cycle, power below this for the Power Off Delay sets the state to Off, instead of the Progress Reset Delay doing it. Set it above the switched-off draw, below standby and the Stop Threshold. 0 disables it (default).
power_off_threshold_w.label: Power Off Threshold

power_profile_interval_min.label: Power Profile Interval
power_profile_interval_min.doc: Bucket size of the power_profile attribute (average watts per slot) used by planners such as EMHASS and tibber_prices. Smaller keeps short spikes; larger smooths the curve. Default 15 min. Does not affect detection.

power_sensor.doc: The sensor that reports this appliance's live power in watts (e.g. sensor.washer_power). All detection is based on it.
power_sensor.label: Power Sensor

profile_evidence_sources.label: Cycles that shape a program
profile_evidence_sources.doc: Which kinds of cycles shape each program's curve and matching. Unticking a kind deletes nothing; useful if you do not trust imported data. Statistics always count only this machine's cycles. Unticking all is ignored.

profile_match_interval.doc: How often to match a running cycle against profiles. Default 300 s (5 min).
profile_match_interval.label: Match Interval

profile_match_max_duration_ratio.doc: A program is dropped once the cycle has run longer than this multiple of its typical duration. 1.8: a cycle 80% longer than the program no longer matches it.
profile_match_max_duration_ratio.label: Max Duration Ratio

profile_match_min_duration_ratio.doc: A program is only considered after the cycle has run this fraction of its typical duration. 0.10: a 2-hour program becomes a candidate after 12 minutes. Not applied in a cycle's first 15 minutes.
profile_match_min_duration_ratio.label: Min Duration Ratio

profile_match_threshold.doc: Live match score a cycle needs before Smart Termination or the anti-crease finish may end it early. It does not change the shown program. Raise it if weak matches end cycles early; lower it if clear matches wait the off delay.
profile_match_threshold.label: Match Threshold

profile_unmatch_threshold.doc: If the live match score drops below this, the current program guess is cleared. Keep it a little below the Match Threshold so a brief dip does not reset it.
profile_unmatch_threshold.label: Unmatch Threshold

progress_reset_delay.doc: After a cycle, keep progress at 100% this long before resetting to Idle.
progress_reset_delay.label: Progress Reset Delay

pump_stuck_duration.doc: How long a pump may run nonstop before the stuck-pump event fires.
pump_stuck_duration.label: Pump Stuck Duration

sampling_interval.doc: Minimum time between processed readings. Readings that arrive sooner are skipped (low readings during a cycle are always kept). Set it to your plug's reporting interval or lower; a higher value only throws readings away.
sampling_interval.label: Sampling Interval

save_debug_traces.doc: Also store the matcher's debug data (every candidate's scores) with each cycle, for troubleshooting. Adds about 20 KB per cycle.
save_debug_traces.label: Save Debug Traces

show_contributor.doc: Show the "by <contributor>" attribution on community appliances and reference cycles.

smart_termination_duration_ratio.doc: Fraction of the program's average duration a cycle must reach before Smart Termination may end it early. If run times vary (water temperature, sensor-dry, load size), lower it (e.g. 0.85). Leave empty for 0.98 (0.99 on dishwashers).
smart_termination_duration_ratio.label: Smart Termination Ratio

start_duration_threshold.doc: Power must stay above the Start Threshold this long before a cycle starts, so brief on/off blips are ignored.
start_duration_threshold.label: Start Duration

start_energy_threshold.doc: Energy the appliance must use before the cycle counts as running. A short power spike uses little energy, so it does not start a cycle.
start_energy_threshold.label: Start Energy

start_threshold_w.doc: Power must rise above this to start a cycle. Too low: standby power causes false starts. Too high: slow-starting programs (cold fill) are missed.
start_threshold_w.label: Start Threshold

stop_threshold_w.doc: Power must fall below this before the off delay starts counting. Keep it below the Start Threshold. Too high, and low-power phases (rinse holds, anti-crease) start the end countdown by mistake.
stop_threshold_w.label: Stop Threshold

store_brand.label: Appliance Brand
store_brand.doc: Optional. Your appliance brand from the community catalog, used to find and share reference recordings. Leave blank if you do not use online features.

store_model.label: Appliance Model
store_model.doc: Optional. Your appliance model from the community catalog (pick a brand first). If it is not listed, you can add it.

switch_entity.doc: Optional switch turned off on pause and back on when resuming, with "Pause Also Cuts Power".
switch_entity.label: Switch Entity

unload_confirm_entity.doc: Optional. Any entity that confirms the load was taken out, for machines without a door sensor (a button, input_button, motion sensor, scene). Every state change counts except turning off or unavailable. Also enables the unload reminder.
unload_confirm_entity.label: Unload Confirmation Entity

unload_track_without_door.doc: Run the unload reminder without a door sensor or confirmation entity. Confirm the unload from your own automation with the "Mark Unloaded" button or the ha_washdata.mark_unloaded service. Ignored when a Door Sensor Entity is set.
unload_track_without_door.label: Confirm Unload Manually

watchdog_interval.doc: How often the background check looks for stalled sensors and timeouts. Default 30 s.
watchdog_interval.label: Watchdog Interval

share_name.doc: Show your account name as the uploader of cycles you share. Off: shared without a name.

status.match_uncertain_tip: WashData has not settled on a program yet. The figure is how often the leading guess, {top}, was right in past cycles when it led by this much. Information only.

auto_label_confidence.higher: Labels fewer cycles automatically; more go to review
auto_label_confidence.lower: Labels more cycles automatically; some may be misidentified

duration_tolerance.higher: Accepts a wider duration range – more flexible matching
duration_tolerance.lower: Requires closer duration match – stricter but may reject unusual cycles

end_energy_threshold.higher: Closes only cycles that used substantial energy
end_energy_threshold.lower: Closes shorter or lower-energy cycles too

learning_confidence.higher: Learns only from very confident matches – slower but more reliable
learning_confidence.lower: Learns from more cycles; model may be noisier

min_off_gap.higher: Longer idle needed before a new cycle starts
min_off_gap.lower: Brief idle triggers a new cycle – back-to-back runs may split

min_power.higher: Less sensitive to idle power draw; may miss very quiet programs
min_power.lower: More sensitive; may log standby power as activity

no_update_active_timeout.higher: More time before declaring a cycle stuck

off_delay.higher: More time for appliance pauses – handles long soak or drying phases
off_delay.lower: Faster end detection – works well for clean on/off appliances

profile_match_threshold.higher: Commits only high-confidence matches; more cycles stay unlabelled
profile_match_threshold.lower: Matches more cycles; some may be slightly wrong

start_threshold_w.higher: Avoids false starts from brief power spikes
start_threshold_w.lower: Catches low-power programs; may trigger on noise

stop_threshold_w.higher: Ends cycle faster – may close during a pause
stop_threshold_w.lower: Waits longer to end – fewer premature completions

watchdog_interval.higher: Longer quiet phases allowed; fewer false force-stops

reason.watchdog: Kept as low as safe (just above the p95 update gap of {p95}s and at least 2x the sampling interval of {median}s, min 30s) so stalls are caught quickly without false stops.
reason.off_delay_pauses: Sized to outlast real pauses: p95 intra-cycle pause {p95}s + 60s buffer, from {pauses} pauses across {cycles} clean cycles (floor {floor}s).
reason.match_interval_capped: Capped so {persistence} consecutive matches fit in {pct}% of the shortest program ({shortest}s); the update cadence (median={median}s) alone would have suggested a longer interval.
reason.match_interval_floored: The shortest program ({shortest}s) would cap this at {cap}s, below the {minimum}s minimum, so the minimum is used: {persistence} consecutive matches take {budget}s, over {pct}% of that program. Matching only runs when a reading arrives (median={median}s), so this costs nothing.
reason.min_power: 40% of the p05 lowest active power ({p05}W) across {cycles} clean cycles, keeping the off-gate below real draw.{excl}
reason.completion_min_seconds: Half the p05 clean-cycle duration ({minutes} min) across {cycles} cycles; filters ghost cycles.{excl}
reason.min_off_gap: Based on {gaps} observed inter-cycle gaps (p05={p05}s). Device floor: {floor}s.
reason.min_off_gap_bridge: Sized to bridge the longest quiet stretch inside a cycle: {span}s + 60s buffer, from {spans} bridged gaps across {cycles} clean cycles (stays under your {ceiling}s back-to-back headroom).
reason.standby_floor: Every recent cycle was still drawing {idle}W when it ended, so a threshold below that can never see the appliance switch off. Kept above it; the {cycles} clean cycles on record never paused under it for more than {pause}s.
reason.thr_batch: Just above the lowest active power (p05) across {cycles} cycles ({p05}W), so starts are caught early and the stop threshold stays below the lowest running power.
reason.max_duration_ratio_default: Back to the default: a lower ceiling rejects the right programme whenever a run is longer than usual.
reason.min_duration_ratio_default: Back to the default: a higher floor stops a running cycle from being recognised until it is well under way.
reason.end_energy_floor: Raised to the floor the stop threshold ({stop} W) over the off delay ({off_delay} s) implies; below it the cycle can only end through a fallback path.

col.profile_tip: Matched program name. Unlabelled means no profile matched at end of cycle.
col.status_tip: Cycle outcome: Completed (natural end), Interrupted (abrupt power drop), Force Stopped (manual), or Needs Review (feedback pending).
col.date_tip: Date and time the cycle started.
col.duration_tip: Total cycle run time from start to end.
col.energy_tip: Total energy used (kWh), computed from power over time.
col.cost_dynamic_tip: Time-weighted: charged at the price in force during the cycle (effective {price} {cur}/kWh).
col.cost_tip: Energy cost of this cycle, fixed when it finished. With Time-Weighted Cost on, each moment is charged at its own price; otherwise at the price at the end. Set a price in Settings to fill this in.
col.confidence_tip: Profile match confidence (0-100%). How closely the cycle power curve matched the identified program.
col.flags_tip: Review, anomaly and source flags for the cycle. Hover an icon for detail.

pg_evd.detected: The detector recognized a cycle had started.
pg_evd.match_commit: The matcher committed to a program with enough confidence.
pg_evd.match_changed: The leading program changed as more of the cycle was seen.
pg_evd.match_ambiguous: Two programs scored close together, so the match was uncertain.
pg_evd.unmatched: No saved program fit this cycle.
pg_evd.notify_start: A start notification would be sent.
pg_evd.notify_pre_complete: An almost-done notification would be sent.
pg_evd.notify_finish: A finish notification would be sent.
pg_evd.notify_milestone: A milestone notification would be sent.
pg_evd.notify_held: A notification was held back for quiet hours.
pg_evd.finished: The cycle reached a terminal state and ended.
pg_evd.match_reverted: The program fell back to detecting: its score dropped well below its own peak.
pg_evd.verified_pause: The live alignment confirmed (or released) a pause inside the program. While it holds, the cycle is not ended.
pg_evd.stalled: The cycle sat at standby draw longer than this program ever pauses there, with work left. Shown as Paused (Stalled); the cycle stays open.
